disclaimerGeneral: General guidance compiled from published TNAU/PAU/ICAR recommendations. Doses vary with your soil and region. Not a substitute for a soil test or advice from your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra / Agriculture Officer. Get a free Soil Health Card: soilhealth.dac.gov.in · Kisan Call Centre 1800-180-1551.
limitations: These are general figures for a region, not a prescription for your field. Soil, variety and season all change what a crop needs.
